newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada judge keeps Saudi in custody, sets hearing.
newsitem.headline: Canada judge keeps Saudi in custody, sets hearing.

text.p: A Canadian judge decided on Thursday not to order the release of a Saudi Arabian dissident wanted by the United States in connection with last June's bombing in Saudi Arabia bombing that killed 19 U.S. airmen.

In a closed-door hearing, the Federal Court judge examined the certificate under which the man, Hani Abdel-Rahim Hussein al-Sayegh, was arrested in Ottawa last week and determined that he given an opportunity to appear at a public court hearing on April 28.
Sayegh, in an Ottawa prison, was not present at Thursday's hearing before Federal Court Justice Donna McGillis.
